literal.prompt: Какой парк Исландии носит имя огромного ледника, покрывающего несколько вулканов?

literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO names Vatnajökull National Park and central same-named c780000ha icecap in Iceland, with eight subglacial volcanoes in property and active examples. The query requires Icelandic protected park named for this icecap, not identifying generic glacier physics. Key3 uniquely matches; two Iguazus Argentina/Brazil and Plitvice Croatia are supported country exclusions. Glacier huge is grounded by area without asserting a comparative largest rank.

literalGroups.literal: Это Ватнайёкюдль. Сочетание льда и вулканизма формирует каньоны, лавовые поля и ледниковые паводки.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Retained two sentences name Vatnajökull and summarize its volcanic/glacial landscape: flat lavafields inL40, ice-volcanism landforms L43–44, meltwater jökulhlaups and evolving canyons L45. This is a collective landscape summary, not a claim that ice alone generates lava or that every lavafield requires glacier contact.

literalGroups.literal: Игуасу в Аргентине вместе с соседним бразильским парком сохраняет значительный остаток Атлантического леса.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Argentinian Iguazu and contiguous Brazilian park preserve a significant protected remnant of Interior Atlantic Forest. Replaces the unestablished western-half simplification; country and conservation fact specifically concern this distractor, not Plitvice or Iceland.

literalGroups.literal: Бразильский национальный парк Игуасу находится в штате Парана и граничит с аргентинским парком.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Brazilian Iguaçu is in Paraná and adjacent to Argentinian Iguazú. Exact supported geography replaces unestablished eastern-bank wording; does not attribute Croatian lakes or Icelandic icecap to this option.

literalGroups.literal: Плитвицкие озёра — хорватский парк с каскадом озёр, разделённых природными травертиновыми плотинами.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Plitvice is Croatian, interconnected lakes are separated by natural travertine/tufa dams deposited as calcium carbonate. Retains this valid original note. On23 the geological material/origin adds beyond turquoise lake chain/park name; on24 it truthfully teaches own wrong option.

literalGroups.literal: Ледниковый покров Ватнайёкюдль в среднем отступает с конца XVIII века; в последние годы его отступание ускорилось из-за потепления.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L41 says the Vatnajökull icecap reached its maximum at end18th century and has on average retreated since; L42 says retreat recently accelerated in response to global warming. Note preserves on-average and recent conditional timeline, not monotonic retreat every year. It adds glacier change history/climate beyond parkname and ice over volcanoes.
